label: Fill nickname of pre-existing members from name
summary: Rows that existed before nickname get left(btrim(name), 12), padded to 2 chars

execute.description: set nickname from name on rows that existed before this migration
execute.sql: UPDATE public.members SET nickname = CASE WHEN char_length(btrim(left(btrim(name), 12))) >= 2 THEN btrim(left(btrim(name), 12)) ELSE left(btrim(name) || '회원', 12) END WHERE nickname = ''

postcheck.description: verify no member is left with an empty nickname
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.members WHERE nickname = '')
